response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a strong, versatile senior full-stack/backend developer with a solid track record across web, mobile, and embedded projects, but his experience does not align with this role's core requirements: no native or apparent Japanese proficiency, no evident C-for-UNIX or Linux kernel source modification experience, and no demonstrated background in LAN-switch security features (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF/SNMP, embedded network security). His skill set is heavily web/TypeScript/DLang oriented rather than embedded C/Linux kernel security work.
strengths: Extensive senior-level software engineering experience (15+ years) across multiple domains
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby
Strong open-source, teaching, and cross-functional collaboration track record
concerns: No mention of Japanese language skills, which is a hard requirement for this role
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation/modification or embedded security protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF/SNMP)
C experience is limited to a brief 2014-2015 stint (LabWindows/CVI), not recent or UNIX/embedded-systems focused

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security protocol experience
